name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring synchronous land-labor scaling (20-22 plots / 10-11 hands), two-tier capital velocity liquidations, duration-feasible town shop arbitrage, in-situ field servicing, and a Day-18 perennial cutoff.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Gates seed procurement strictly by duration-feasibility to prevent dead capital in slow crops, routing matching inventory before open-market liquidation.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Maintains high capital velocity via calibrated batch sales of unreserved surplus holdings at favorable prices (>=0.84x base), protecting shed headroom while strictly prohibiting panic dumps below 0.78x.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to front-run confirmed high-probability opponent market gluts (>=0.60 risk) on sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) before prices collapse.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Synchronous Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into synchronous land-labor scaling (20-22 plots matched to 10-11 hands by Day 15-16), hyper-fertilized Strawberries through Day 18, and post-Day-18 3-day turnaround Carrots.

nodes.name: In-Situ Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Dispatches hands with in-situ harvest-and-water servicing to eliminate transit latency and growth halts, enforcing bag clustering before shed drop-offs and full end-of-day deposit clearance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? n_animals * 3 : 0); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 200.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Procure exact seed quantities for active shop demands strictly when duration-feasible: (current_day + crop_growth_days <= contract_deadline_day and contract_deadline_day <= 28). If growth duration exceeds the deadline, fulfill strictly from existing shed inventory or bypass the contract.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase seeds for contracts that cannot mature before deadline (stranding capital in uncontracted slow crops). Never uproot or displace mature multi-harvest Strawberry plots for shop contracts. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.5x midnight payroll.

attributes.condition: ((day <= 6 and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 5) or (day > 6 and uncontracted_surplus_inventory >= 14) or shed_used >= 35 or day >= 29)
attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved surplus holdings at favorable market prices (>= 0.84 * base_price) to maintain capital velocity without transaction friction. If shed occupancy hits congestion (shed_used >= 70), relax price floor to 0.78 * base_price to protect shed headroom, but strictly prohibit selling below 0.78 * base_price prior to Day 29. On Days 29-30, execute terminal sweep to clear remaining unreserved stock.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never dump below 0.78 * base_price during Days 1-28. Never retain unsold surplus past Day 30 step 716. Dynamic livestock wheat reserve must be 0 when n_animals == 0.

attributes.guidance: Preempt opponent price collapses by executing rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when a confirmed high-probability glut signal (risk >= 0.60) is detected while price remains favorable (>= 0.80 * base_price).
attributes.pitfalls: Do not panic dump on low-confidence noise signals (< 0.60); never dump commodities into already collapsed markets (< 0.60 * base_price) unless shed is 100% full. Never front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 80.0 and (hired_hands < 11 or total_plots < 22 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce aggressively to 10-11 hands by Day 12-14. Synchronously expand contiguous land matched to labor: 8-10 plots at 3-4 hands (Days 4-6), 14-16 plots at 6-7 hands (Days 8-10), and 20-22 plots at 9-11 hands (completed by Day 15-16). After initial Carrot bootstrapping (Days 1-4), transition 100% of newly expanded plots to hyper-fertilized Strawberries through Day 18. After Day 18, enforce a strict ban on new Strawberry planting and fertilizer purchasing; all remaining or newly opened uncultivated plots post-Day 18 must pivot exclusively to fast 3-day Carrots or duration-feasible shop contracts.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 22 plots or after Day 16. Never plant new Strawberries after Day 18 (insufficient time to amortize seed cost across multi-harvest cycles). Never purchase fertilizer for post-Day 18 crops. Do not buy single-harvest slow crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) unless explicitly required by a duration-feasible shop contract.

attributes.guidance: Execute in-situ plot servicing pipeline: 1) Harvest ripe plot, 2) Immediately water that exact plot in-situ before moving to eliminate dry pauses and avoid re-transit waste, 3) Service adjacent plots until worker carry limit (3-4 items) is reached, 4) Route directly to shed for deposit, 5) On departure from shed, equip fertilizer/seeds only if moving to unserviced/unplanted plots. Secondary priority: Feed livestock (if n_animals > 0), then weed/till. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited in shed by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize in-situ watering, as unwatered crops halt regrowth clocks. Never allow 1-crop transit cycles that waste worker steps. Never leave carried crops in worker inventory past step 716. Never leave workers idle when ripe crops or dry plots remain.
